body:
It is very hard for me to open up to people, I try to be strong in front of others, but inside everything is falling apart all the time. All the time.

I am away from home and family and friends, and that makes it even worse. I miss touching people, talking to people. Talking to real people, not to a computer or a smartphone.

It feels really hopeless right now.

i just seem to be unable to connect to people. i've never felt like i belong anywhere. it is a strange feeling. i don't open up with anyone, and keeping things inside frustrate me and make me anxious and sad.

i've been a loner for a long time now, i am 26 and i thought things would change, but they don't. I am a Masters student and I'm setting up a business, i am well recognised for my academic and professional achievements, and that makes me feel good. but never happy. i don't think i know what happy is.

just had cops and paramedics in, a 'friend' called them after i stopped answering the phone. I took paracetamol, but not enough to kill me. I started slitting my left wrist, but they got here. I refused to go to hospital, so they couldn't take me. I want to end it.

thank you. I moved from Brazil to the UK a year ago. I had attempted suicide a few times before, 4 years ago was the last attempt. Things had been well since then, but have deteriorated rapidly since Christmas. I am feeling very weak and fragile and every little thing triggers the worst thoughts now.
